mapper.select: SELECT term_id, term, definition, category FROM glossary
SELECT term_id, term, definition, category FROM glossary ORDER BY category ASC, term ASC

SELECT term_id, term, definition, category FROM glossary
WHERE term LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR definition LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY category ASC, term ASC
SELECT term_id, term, definition, category FROM glossary WHERE category = #{category} ORDER BY term ASC
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM glossary ORDER BY category ASC
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM glossary WHERE term LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR definition LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY category ASC
SELECT term_id, term, definition, category FROM glossary WHERE category = #{category} AND ( term LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR definition LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY term ASC

SELECT term FROM glossary WHERE term LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN term LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, term ASC LIMIT 8
